app.name: SIO
app.tagline: Set up Windows the way you like it

dashboard.title: System overview
dashboard.subtitle: What this machine is running right now
dashboard.lowSpaceWarning: Running low on space — a large install profile may not fit

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences for this app
settings.languageHint: Follows your Windows language by default
settings.adminHint: SIO starts without administrator rights. It asks only when a change actually needs them, and then reuses that permission for the rest of the session.
settings.adminTestExplain: Writes one value to the registry and immediately undoes it. Windows will ask for permission.
settings.adminTestOk: Worked — the change was applied and reverted.
settings.updatesHint: SIO never updates itself in the background. Check when you want to.
settings.upToDate: You are on the latest version.

apps.title: Apps
apps.subtitle: Pick what you want, install it in one pass
apps.noSources: No package manager was found. winget ships with Windows 11 — updating App Installer from the Store usually fixes this.

tweaks.title: Tuning
tweaks.subtitle: Privacy, performance and interface — every change can be undone
tweaks.confirmRisk: This one changes how Windows behaves. Read the description before continuing.
tweaks.confirmIrreversible: Removing an app cannot be undone by SIO — getting it back needs the Microsoft Store.
tweaks.restorePointCreated: A restore point was created first.
tweaks.restorePointThrottled: No restore point: Windows makes at most one per day, and one already exists. Your changes can still be undone individually.
tweaks.restorePointDisabled: No restore point: System Protection is turned off for this drive. Your changes can still be undone individually.
tweaks.restartRequired: Restart Windows for everything to take effect.
tweaks.revertFailed: Some changes could not be put back.
tweaks.empty: No tuning options apply to this version of Windows.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Save what you picked, then replay it after the next reinstall
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Pick some apps on the Apps screen, then save them here.
profiles.nothingSelected: Nothing is selected yet — pick some apps first.
profiles.openFolderHint: Profiles are plain JSON files. Copy one to a USB stick before you wipe the machine, and drop it back here afterwards.
